The Minutes of a called meeting of the City Council
Austin June 10, 1889

Hon Joseph C Nalle Mayor presiding

Roll
Roll call. Present Aldermen
Aisman Nepsodle Gillis
Boland North
Eagleston Schneider
Lemm Northam

Call.
Absent Aldermen
De Grass Newton
Hayler Olford
Jones Platt
Lawrence Townsend
Metz Wilson
Morris

Call
Council
The following was then read
To the Board of Aldermen &c
In pursuance of Section (5)
Five section (1) one of the City Charter. I hereby call a special Meeting of the City
Council to meet at the Council Chamber at the City Hall on this day (June 10th 1889) at 8
1/2 o'clock P.M. for the purpose of laying before you a certified copy of an order made by
the Commissioners Court of Travis County, rescinding the contract existing between the
City of Austin and Travis County in regard to maintaining the City and County Hospital
Austin Texas June 10th 1889
Joseph C Nalle
Mayor.

Under Call.
Alderman Gillis moved a call of the Council which was agreed to and the Marshal instructed
to bring in the Absentees a recess of twenty (20) minutes was taken when Aldermen Jones
and Newton answered to their names.

Hospital.
The Mayor then introduced the following copy of an order of the Commissioners Court to
wit: “On this May 21st 1889 it was ordered by the Court that the contract between Austin
City and Travis County in reference to Hospital be annulled”


 --- Page break --- 

483
State of Texas }
Travis County } I hereby certify the above to be a true copy of the original order of the
Commissioners Court of Travis County, Texas, as the same appears of record in my office.
Given under my hand and seal of said Court. June 7th 1889.
Frank Brown. Clerk.

" Alderman Poland made a motion that the Mayor appoint a Committee of three to confer with
the Commissioners Court of Travis County and to report their action at a subsequent
Meeting of the City Council to be called by the Mayor.
After a few desultory remarks, pro and con, engaged in by Aldermen Poland, Millett,
Graham, Smith and Miller.
Alderman Graham moved that the words "Hospital Committee" be substituted for "Committee of
three" which was agreed to and Alderman Polands motion as amended passed unanimously.

On motion the Council adjourned
Nate McCarley
City Clerk, Pro tem.
